title: Run overview
summary: Run state, Fate Points, spins and the outstanding obligation.
blocked: Connect a supported saved run before gameplay actions are available.
binding: Identity-bound lifecycle, ledger, spin state and obligation snapshot; absent values are not zero.

title: Gameplay sidebar
summary: A narrow status panel with the information needed during normal play.
blocked: Gameplay actions depend on the supported current account.
binding: Same immutable snapshot/presenter as Overview; host sidebar width wraps without horizontal scrolling.

title: Mode and account setup
summary: Explicit opt-in, connected account identity and save availability.
blocked: Live identity/directory/session binding is required; no guessed account identity.
binding: FoundationPreview/AsyncRunSession plus supported live identity adapter; no editing account IDs in UI.

title: Save status and recovery
summary: Show readable save health and safe recovery choices.
blocked: Do not reset, overwrite or mark a corrupt/newer save recovered from this screen.
binding: Typed codec/store inspection; preserve files and obligation, show uncertainty distinctly from empty/new save.

title: Start-run eligibility
summary: Check the protected tutorial/mainland flow before creating a run.
blocked: Unknown eligibility blocks creation; this is not a free reset/new-run escape.
binding: Authoritative initialization predicate, durable seal/staging and original-command replay.

title: Pause and resume
summary: Pause preserves the run and its outstanding obligations.
consequences: Paused gains do not advance objectives or pay new rewards.
Existing Fate, progress and obligations remain.
Resuming requires the same validated run context.
blocked: Await a connected lifecycle and the permitted transition.
binding: Revision-checked lifecycle gateway; no view-only pause flag or automatic clearing of obligations.

title: Master Wheel access
summary: Open the existing wheel with its current appearance and behavior.
blocked: This prototype does not draw, reroll or replace the existing Master Wheel.
binding: Existing popup renderer plus mode commitment/readiness; skip animation reveals the same committed result.

title: Fate offerings
summary: Standard target first, then frozen offers, then random target selection.
blocked: No boss picker or reroll. The UI never generates replacement offers.
binding: Immutable durable offers, distinct starting Standard targets, two/three capacity and card-before-target sequence.

title: Owned Fate Cards
summary: Inspect permanently owned types and offering upgrades.
blocked: Owning a card does not select a boss or make a target eligible.
binding: Versioned card ownership/offer catalog; normal and Challenge families remain distinct.

title: Active Fate detail
summary: One objective panel reused for XP, combat, boss KC, quests and Slayer.
blocked: No manual completion credit from this screen; only supported evidence may satisfy an objective.
binding: Committed assignment snapshot, type-specific progress projection and atomic settlement capability.

title: Quest choices
summary: Display the actual committed quest choices and qualification reasons.
blocked: Unknown data is not empty. Known-empty landing retries free with the slice retained.
binding: Resolved backend choice capacity/tier mapping; saved choices do not refresh on reopen.

title: Boss eligibility
summary: Read-only pool membership, unlock status and actual eligibility.
blocked: Inspecting a boss does not choose the assignment or unlock its access requirements.
binding: Actual committed eligible pool; eligibility filters affect only legal future selections.

title: Challenge item hunt
summary: The exact assigned item, creature and qualifying source context.
blocked: Old items, withdrawals and other uniques do not satisfy this assignment. No pity kill cap.
binding: Frozen one-item/source/rank/reward assignment and supported fresh active personal drop receipt.

title: Completion and reward result
summary: Show the saved settlement outcome after durable acknowledgment.
blocked: A proposed transition is not successful settlement; lost acknowledgment is reconciled using the same command ID.
binding: Atomic settlement receipt and current snapshot; never award or debit from rendered UI state.

title: Reject / failure consequences
summary: Review exact consequences before a permitted Reject action.
consequences: Show forfeited objective reward and mandatory punishment where applicable.
Independent bounty rewards already paid are retained.
Pending settlement survives closing and reopening.
blocked: No guessed numeric loss, punishment or recovery waiver.
binding: Current identity/revision, approved consequence quote and atomic Reject/failure gateway.

title: Off-task tolerance warning
summary: Explain off-task XP and the remaining allowance.
blocked: The warning does not settle a penalty or invent a new tolerance value.
binding: Supported XP attribution, active objective boundary and domain audit/settlement state.

title: Grand Fate reveal
summary: Reveal the sealed initial destiny using the selected GF4 wheel when available.
fields: Only if still permitted by sealed initialization state
blocked: Five equal-weight approved goals; no new draw from reopening, no arbitrary extra reroll.
binding: Original Grand seal/staging and explicitly allowed one initial reroll transition; renderer never supplies randomness.

title: Grand Fate checklist
summary: Display the selected destiny and its retained verified components.
blocked: Master goal is hilt 5; Awakened components retain independent progress; Radiant uses the approved full-set objective.
binding: Identity-bound sealed checklist/progress; reference structure alone is not authenticated completion evidence.

title: Grand Fate attempt
summary: Begin a permitted attempt on an unfinished sealed component.
consequences: Existing mandatory obligations block entry.
Grand attempt has no Master spin charge.
Previously verified component progress remains.
blocked: Trusted evidence, durable attempt commands and settlement remain required.
binding: Current lifecycle/seal/progress plus revision-checked durable attempt service; no UI-only activation.

title: Fate Tree — simple list
summary: Four branches in a plain upgrade list; the graphical tree can replace this view later.
rows: Skill unlocks and approved count gates
blocked: No custom graph renderer is required for this first list; shared catalog/rules remain authoritative.
binding: One production catalog and prerequisite projection shared with future tree renderer; no duplicated visual-only rules.

title: Upgrade and prerequisites
summary: Readable benefit, ALL/ANY/count requirements and a standard Unlock button.
blocked: Unknown prices are not free. Higher Challenge ranks retain lower ownership.
binding: Graph visitor/unique-count evaluator, catalog quote and atomic entitlement+debit+benefit transaction.

title: Wheel Builder
summary: A simple list of active slice instances and available slot capacity.
blocked: Validate five ordinary slices, three distinct activities and 24 total slots together.
binding: Actual SliceInventory/ActiveWheel/WheelOdds read model; edits use real legal-boundary/transaction services.

title: Satchel / stored slices
summary: Stored instances, capacity and legal reactivation.
blocked: Reactivating the same instance does not count as a new purchase or new lifetime acquisition.
binding: Shared inventory instance identity, Satchel capacity and authoritative edit validation.

title: Slice edit confirmation
summary: Preview one legal add, store, reactivate, replace, enhance or destroy operation.
consequences: Cancel or Undo leaves saved inventory unchanged.
Questing cannot be destroyed; capacity and activity minima remain valid.
Inventory, lifetime history and any debit commit together.
blocked: In-memory inventory/purchase proposals alone are not durable successful edits.
binding: Draft presenter, current edit boundary, versioned quote and atomic inventory transaction receipt.

title: Shop — upgrades and products
summary: Ordinary product rows and normal buttons; no flashing sign.
blocked: Unreviewed products cannot be purchased. No provisional numeric schedules become prices through the UI.
binding: Versioned product catalog, owned entitlements, availability and shared purchase gateway.

title: Vendor unlocks
summary: Vendor entitlement, actual access and restriction evidence are separate.
blocked: Do not claim unsupported access enforcement works. Retain Trade with and show the approved local notice.
binding: Vendor product gateway and independently supported interaction/location/policy adapter capability.

title: Challenge ranks and readiness
summary: Owned, enabled and ready are distinct for each retained rank.
blocked: Changes apply only at the approved safe boundary. All off is allowed; no per-target toggles or four extra offer slots.
binding: D147–150 progressive ownership/shared bundle/target entitlements and future-offer rank settings capability.

title: Bounties
summary: Item icon, description and Fate Points in compact rows.
rows: Approved item goal and qualifying source
blocked: No Claim button: qualifying active rewards pay automatically. Paused gains do not backfill.
binding: Actual bounty catalog, entitlements and independent once-only acquisition/reward receipts; no failure clawback.

title: Shared purchase confirmation
summary: One confirmation pattern reused by upgrades, slices and shop products.
consequences: Disable repeated submit while pending.
State or quote changes require another review.
Lost acknowledgment reconciles the same command ID.
blocked: Only durable acknowledgment shows success; never debit ledger separately from product grant.
binding: Typed revision/identity/quote-bound product gateway and idempotent atomic receipt.

title: Zero-spins decision
summary: When no spins remain, show only the legal Grand or Defy routes.
blocked: Do not grant spins, bypass an obligation or start a Grand attempt merely by navigating here.
binding: Authoritative zero-spin capability and current Grand/Defy eligibility.

title: Defy Fate consequences
summary: Show the actual refill, special odds and displacement together.
consequences: Taint is its own special slice, not a recolored skill.
24 shared slots remain; Questing can only be displaced through legal storage.
Preview permanent consequences before one durable command.
blocked: No guessed grants, weights, extra slots or invented replacement rules.
binding: Current wheel state, approved Defy rules, legal full-capacity selection and atomic grant/injection receipt.

title: Taint and Punishment obligation
summary: Plain pending-task details before special-wheel artwork is added.
blocked: Obligation survives close/restart. Opening a task does not count as completing it.
binding: Committed punishment/taint state, trusted progress and mandatory settlement service; preserve Master/GF4/B3 themes.

title: Sacrifice / Coffer evidence
summary: Explain pending donation eligibility and missing verification.
blocked: Known no eligible item: acquire an eligible item worth at least 10,000 GP. Unknown bank evidence requires refresh, not that assumption.
binding: Verified current-client Coffer adapter only; no guessed donation, forced death or invented obligation waiver.

title: Fate’s Pardon
summary: Review fixed-price taint-debt removal separately from normal unlocking.
consequences: Unlimited purchases; no remaining-use counter.
Removes taint debt only.
Separate unlock or gamble action is still required after restoration.
blocked: No invented price or forgiveness of unrelated obligations/penalties.
binding: Atomic taint-only restoration plus approved fixed-price debit and replay receipt.

title: Notifications and recent receipts
summary: Read-only durable events and concise notices.
blocked: No fabricated prior-run history, replayed reward animation or claim action.
binding: Bounded persisted receipts/notifications with once-only acknowledgment display and no private account identifiers.

title: Settings and help
summary: Plain preferences and short instructions; richer visuals can be added later.
blocked: Preferences never refresh a committed offer or weaken evidence requirements.
binding: View-only preferences separate from authoritative legal gameplay settings commands; help follows current decisions.
